module: Flowgraph 'link' class: a link between an output pin (sourcePin) and an input pin (targetPin) of two nodes of a graph. On creation, it registers itself in graph.links, writes the source pin into targetNode.pinIn, maintains the multiple-flow list (_mInFlow) for flow pins, notifies pins and nodes (_onLink) and picks its color from the pin type. It also draws the link in the editor (imgui / ui_flowgraph_editor). The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/link')(graph, sourcePin, targetPin).
notes: A link has two ids: id and hiddenId (used for highlighting), both requested from mgr:getNextFreePinLinkId().
Compact serialization: {source node id, source pin name, target node id, target pin name, hidden}.
A 'state' → 'state' link is drawn between the transition pins (N/S/E/W) according to the relative position of the nodes, with a label showing the source pin name.
convertToQuickAccess replaces the links from the same source pin with a quick access (quickAccess + unique accessName, numeric suffix if the name exists) then deletes the selection.

color.desc: pin type color; special colors for impulse and chainFlow

C.desc: Link object returned by the constructor.

init.desc: Creates the link, registers it in the graph and notifies pins and nodes.

drawLinkTooltip.desc: Shows the tooltip of the hovered link: icon and type of the source pin and its current value.

getDirPins.desc: For state links: returns the pair of directions ('E','W' / 'W','E' / 'S','N' / 'N','S') according to the position of the nodes, or nil,nil without positions.

draw.desc: Draws the link in the editor with a flow animation when the source pin is active in the current frame (never if the manager is stopped, zero speed when paused).

doFlow.desc: Requests a flow animation on the next draw frame.

drawLabel.desc: Draws the label (source pin name) in the middle of a state link.

showContextMenu.desc: Context menu of the link: hide / show, delete (if editing is allowed) and, if the preference flowgraph.debug.displayIds is active, ids.

convertToQuickAccess.desc: Turns the links leaving the source pin into a named quick access (see notes) then deletes the selection.

__onDeserialized.desc: Restores the hidden state from data[5].
